faqs.question: What amenities are included in Surf and Racquet Club Gulf Shores vacation rentals?
faqs.answer: Surf and Racquet Club Gulf Shores features several luxury amenities including: outdoor pool, hot tub, piers, boat launch, tennis courts, pickleball courts, shuffleboard, covered parking and barbeque grills.

faqs.question: What types of units are available for rent at Gulf Shores Surf & Racquet Club?
faqs.answer: Gulf Shores Surf & Racquet Club offers spacious 3-, and 4- bedroom units, ranging in size from approximately 1,549 to 2,091 square feet.

faqs.question: What popular attractions are close to Gulf Shores Surf and Racquet Club?
faqs.answer: At Gulf Shores Surf and Racquet Club, you’ll enjoy direct access to Little Lagoon via two piers and a boat launch. Directly across the street, you’ll also have beach access to enjoy Gulf Shore’s most popular attraction, the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf. faqs.answer: Check-in and check-out times vary by season. For more information, refer to our Check In and Check Out Times Pageand review your booking confirmation message.

faqs.question: Do all Gulf Shores Surf and Racquet Club rentals have Gulf or Bay views?
faqs.answer: Yes, all Gulf Shores Surf and Racquet Club condos feature either bayfront views of Little Lagoon or views of the Gulf across the street.

faqs.question: Is there beach access available at Phoenix Gulf Shores Surf & Racquet Club?
faqs.answer: Yes, Gulf Shores Surf & Racquet Club features beach access right across the street, and we also offer beach chair rentals for guests.

faqs.question: Is there a grocery store nearby Phoenix Gulf Shores Surf and Racquet Club where guests can purchase food, supplies and necessities?
faqs.answer: Yes, there are several grocery stores located near Surf and Racquet Club Gulf Shores, including Publix, Walmart, and Target. Grocery delivery is offered at participating stores with partnering apps.

faqs.question: Does Phoenix Gulf Shores Surf & Racquet Club have accessibility options?
faqs.answer: Gulf Shores Surf & Racquet Club is equipped with accessibility features to ensure that guests can enjoy their stay. The resort has accessible entrances and public areas, including ramps and elevators. The units were also originally designed with accessibility in mind. Contact us at 1-800-211-7892 to discuss accommodations and options.

faqs.question: Is Phoenix Gulf Shores Surf and Racquet Club a good choice for family vacations?
faqs.answer: Yes, Phoenix Gulf Shores Surf and Racquet Club is a wonderful choice for a Gulf Coast family vacation. Phoenix Gulf Shores Surf and Racquet Club condos provide comfortable options for families of all sizes. You’ll also find plenty of family-friendly amenities for children of all ages, like an outdoor pool and hot tub, tennis and pickleball courts, shuffleboard, a boat launch, barbeques, and more. faqs.question: Is there free Wi-Fi available at Phoenix Gulf Shores Surf & Racquet Club?
